method.task_setting: Build an LLM-centric 3D understanding pipeline that remains effective when paired 3D supervision is limited.
method.paper_method_goal: Present a text-heavy pre-alignment route (T3D + staged tuning) and then transfer that alignment to point-cloud inputs with minimal extra 3D pairing.
method.mainline: T3D text-heavy alignment -> 3-stage transfer recipe -> 0M-Pooling-enabled efficient point-token use
story_order: Stage II: Rich Text Alignment with LoRA

pipeline_steps.name: Stage I: Text-Projector Bootstrapping
pipeline_steps.description: Use caption-to-brief-description style supervision to make projector outputs usable by the LLM under mostly frozen backbones.
pipeline_steps.purpose: Use caption-to-brief-description style supervision to make projector outputs usable by the LLM under mostly frozen backbones.

pipeline_steps.name: Stage II: Rich Text Alignment with LoRA
pipeline_steps.description: Expand to richer descriptions and dialogue-style supervision so the LLM learns stronger instruction-context grounding before touching much 3D data.
pipeline_steps.purpose: Expand to richer descriptions and dialogue-style supervision so the LLM learns stronger instruction-context grounding before touching much 3D data.
outputs: text-side multimodal alignment ready for transfer

pipeline_steps.name: Stage III: Point-Language Transfer via Shared Projector
pipeline_steps.description: Switch to point-cloud tokens, compress token length (0M-Pooling narrative), and reuse the bridge to produce 3D-grounded responses with limited paired data.
pipeline_steps.purpose: Switch to point-cloud tokens, compress token length (0M-Pooling narrative), and reuse the bridge to produce 3D-grounded responses with limited paired data.

innovations.what: 0M-Pooling combines sampling, neighborhood aggregation, and cross-token interaction to shrink point tokens (e.g., from long sequences to compact sets) before language fusion.
Main novelty emphasis is staged alignment strategy plus data curriculum, not redesign of the base LLM architecture.

design_intents.intent: Use million-scale synthetic text supervision (T3D) to front-load alignment and reduce dependence on expensive 3D point-text pairs.
Keep the same projector path through all stages so text-side alignment can be reused for point-side grounding.
Retain rich point-token information while controlling context cost through 0M-Pooling style compression.

potential_mismatches.description: Large inherited framework code (e.g., LLaVA/PointNet++ regions) may be mistaken as this method's own contribution.
Stage narratives can drift if command scripts and runtime flags do not match the intended Stage I/II/III partition.
Dataset-construction storyline (Qwen prompts, source category pools) may be over-asserted if not represented in this code snapshot.
